title: athyrium unifurcatum var. subfluviale
intro: Athyrium unifurcatum var. subfluviale, commonly known as Asian Lady fern, is a type of flowering plant in the Athyriaceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its reported health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and promote healing. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Asian Lady fern include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
